tests: A module-level store with a subscribe and unsubscribe effect, an effect that sets and clears one timer per toast, many useCallback handlers, a ref callback, a keyed list and a memo child.
adaptation: core/store.ts, core/use-toaster.ts and components/toaster.tsx joined with types and enums turned into plain objects. UPSERT_TOAST, the remove queue (addToRemoveQueue and its effect), the toast API, goober styles and the reduced-motion check are removed. toast.dismiss is inlined as a dispatch. ToastBar is reduced to a memo child that prints the message and carries bump('Child'). bump('merge') is added in useStore. SeededToaster is new: it clears and seeds the store on first render so each scenario starts alike. Scenarios use one toasterId per scenario.
